reviews.rationale: ACCEPT the exact complete source/English/note unit supplied in the hash-bound one-row projection. This is a new whole-unit assessment after the immutable source/grammar freeze, not an additional blind reviewer and not a vote based only on active/passive resolution. Both dwell clauses, all as object, starred first locative, dry land, beneath, plural ends, and heaven have been checked against actual original photos. The English and exact mandatory technical note are supported without adding an agent, replacing the selected source with reported alternatives, or modernizing the cosmology. The earlier provisional quantifier transcription and apparent same-pattern observation/corrections remain retained in the prior freeze/provenance. This accepts the selected Charles1906 unit only; it does not prove an autograph or a specific older edition token, provide human certification, or authorize publication.

complete_unit_checks.evidence: Whole native Charles leaf137/printed99 was re-viewed after candidate opened. Candidate full source matches the separately frozen corrected diplomatic string exactly, including initial conjunction, both inhabitants clauses, actual * before ዲበ, accusative ኵሎ, beneath, ends, and singular heaven. It is not silently replaced by apparatus alternatives.

Frozen actual source/grammar controls apply unchanged: selected ወይደመስሱ is ground-stem active imperfect indicative 3mp, not the reported ወይደመሰሱ. Original grammar198-200 demonstrates the penultimate-s difference; grammar203/204 demonstrates y-prefix/-u 3mp. Original Latin1088-1089 supports wipe out as destructive, not a repair/washing verb; Latin814 marks ኵሎ accusative. English they will wipe out all does not introduce a named actor or promote the object to subject. Future will is a normal contextual imperfect rendering, not a claim that the morphology itself is a dedicated future tense.

Original Latin613-614 full dwelling entry and continuation support commorari, habitare, incolere, sedem et domicilium habere for ኀደረ. The same selected የኀድሩ occurs twice. English those who dwell ... and those who dwell preserves both relative clauses and their conjunction rather than merging the second away. All governs the coordinated inhabitant groups.

The selected *ዲበ is a locative, not a voice mark on the verb. Original Latin1103 full ዲበ entry has super, supra, in, and continuation1104-1105 controls its range. Actual Latin1071 bottom supports የብስ as aridum vel siccum, terra vel continens, opposed to water/river/sea, continued1072. On dry land is supported; it does not substitute earth for heaven in the second clause.

Actual Latin553-555 lower/beneath family was viewed completely; Latin555 explicitly supplies infra/subter/subtus and prepositional use of the selected መትሕተ. Actual Latin1294 full end/extremity entry and continuation1295 supply extremitas, finis, terminus with plural and heaven examples. Actual Latin341 supplies ሰማይ, coelum. Beneath the ends of heaven keeps the under relation, plural extremities, and heaven complement. It neither modernizes this to the globe/horizon nor supplies a new cosmological explanation.
